source: L. DiCarlo, J. M. Chow, J. M. Gambetta, L. S. Bishop, B. R. Johnson, D. I. Schuster, J. Majer, A. Blais, L. Frunzio, S. M. Girvin, R. J. Schoelkopf, 'Demonstration of two-qubit algorithms with a superconducting quantum processor', Nature 460, 240-244 (9 July 2009), doi:10.1038/nature08121
location: Fig. 3 caption ('Entanglement on demand': metrics of the four entangler outputs obtained by maximum-likelihood two-qubit state tomography with a joint dispersive readout), plus the abstract; per-quantity locations below.
comment: The standard transmon two-qubit tomography reference used as the MEASURED cross-check for the resolvable log-negativity (negativity_resolution_nats in circuit_qed_harvesting/teixido-bonfill_2026_table1.json). Two transmons in a coplanar-waveguide cavity, joint dispersive readout, maximum-likelihood reconstruction. The uncertainties are the standard deviation over 16 repetitions of generation-plus-tomography, i.e. a run-to-run precision of the reconstructed metrics; they are quoted for highly entangled Bell-type states (C ~ 0.8-0.94), not for the weakly entangled states of entanglement harvesting, and reflect 2009-era readout. The bounds on the imaginary density-matrix elements (which vanish for the ideal Bell states) are a direct element-level noise floor of the reconstruction.
provenance_tags: Per-quantity 'provenance' is 'transcribed' throughout; no synthetic or derived quantities ('synthetic_quantities' empty, asserted by tests/test_experiments_io.py). 'kind' is 'measured'.

concurrence.note: 'Extracted metrics for the four entangler outputs include concurrence C = 0.88 +- 0.02, 0.94 +- 0.01, 0.86 +- 0.02, 0.81 +- 0.04' for the C-Phase gates cU10, cU00, cU11, cU01 respectively; 'The uncertainties correspond to the standard deviation in 16 repetitions of generation-tomography for each entangler'

purity.note: P = Tr(rho^2) of the four reconstructed states

bell_state_fidelity.note: fidelity to the ideal Bell state; the paper defines its fidelity as the square of the fidelity commonly used in the literature (main text)

imaginary_element_bound.note: 'imaginary elements of rho_ml are less than 0.03, 0.02, 0.07, 0.08' for the four outputs -- these elements vanish for the target Bell states, so the bounds are an element-level noise floor of the reconstruction

tomography_repetitions.note: number of independent generation-tomography repetitions over which the standard deviations were taken

max_concurrence.note: 'highly entangled states with concurrence up to 94 per cent'

readout.value: joint dispersive readout of two transmons through a common cavity; density matrix by maximum-likelihood state tomography
